The font and license are copied byte for byte from the pinned upstream tree.
No conversion, subsetting, renaming of font metadata, or global installation.
WOFF2 was selected as the smallest current-release math font supplied upstream.
The complete OpenType math glyph set and MATH data are preserved.
"OpenLearn Math" is only the CSS family alias; the font binary is unmodified.
The font retains its SIL Open Font License 1.1, separately from the app license.
